_how_it_works: One entry per category (the category name as in Monitoring Scope). Each search sentence is sent to Exa news search; {competitor} is replaced by the competitor name. Only categories ticked for the client are searched. A ticked category that is not in this file uses the old automatic search. Later these move to the admin console.

General Updates.about: Financial results, annual / sustainability reports, outlook, big company announcements
searches: {competitor} reports quarterly results net sales and profit
{competitor} raises or cuts its full-year outlook guidance
{competitor} publishes annual report or sustainability report

Product & Feature Launches.about: New products, new ranges, new features, relaunches, discontinued products
searches: {competitor} unveils new collection range or line

Bundles & Packaging.about: New packaging, refills, gift sets, bundles, limited editions, sustainable packaging
searches: {competitor} new packaging design or refillable packaging
{competitor} limited edition gift set or bundle

Pricing & Promotions.about: Price rises or cuts, discounts, promotions, loyalty programmes, subscription plans
searches: {competitor} cuts prices or launches discount promotion
{competitor} launches loyalty programme or membership offer

Marketing & Social Campaigns.about: Ad campaigns, brand ambassadors, influencer and social media campaigns, events, sponsorships
searches: {competitor} names new brand ambassador or face of the brand

Brand & Positioning.about: Rebranding, new logo or identity, repositioning, new brand purpose or target customer
searches: {competitor} rebrand new logo or brand identity
{competitor} repositions brand new strategy target customers
{competitor} brand relaunch premium or mass market shift

Partnerships & Alliances.about: Partnerships with companies, retailers, tech firms, collaborations, licensing deals
searches: {competitor} signs licensing or distribution agreement with retailer

M&A, Funding & Investments.about: Acquisitions, mergers, sale of brands, stakes, investments in plants, funds or start-ups
searches: {competitor} invests million in new plant facility or start-up
{competitor} takes stake in company venture fund

Leadership & Org Changes.about: New CEO or executives, leaders leaving, restructuring, layoffs, big hiring plans
searches: {competitor} appoints new CEO or chief executive

Geographic & Segment Expansion.about: Entering new countries or cities, new stores, new channels (e-commerce, marketplaces), new customer segments
searches: {competitor} opens first store in new city or country
{competitor} launches on new e-commerce platform or marketplace
{competitor} expands into new category or customer segment

Technology & AI Adoption.about: AI tools, new technology, digital platforms, apps, data platforms, tech partnerships
searches: {competitor} launches AI tool or generative AI feature
{competitor} partners with technology company on AI data cloud
{competitor} launches new app or virtual try-on

Customer Wins & Reputation.about: Awards, rankings, certifications, major customer or retailer wins, recalls and complaints, public criticism

Regulatory, Legal & Compliance.about: Lawsuits, fines, regulator actions, investigations, settlements, new rules affecting the company
